title: UPSSSC Latest and Upcoming Recruitment 2026 Through PET 2025
organization: Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC)
postName: UPSSSC Latest / Upcoming Main Examinations Through PET 2025
vacancyDetails: Multiple UPSSSC recruitment examinations through PET 2025, including Senior Instructor, Computer Operator, Junior Engineer Agriculture, Veterinary Pharmacist, LEO and other posts.
qualification: Candidates must have appeared in UPSSSC PET 2025 with a valid score and must meet the post-wise educational qualification prescribed in the respective notification.
ageLimit: As per the respective UPSSSC recruitment notification, with applicable relaxation for reserved categories.
applicationFee: UR / General, OBC, EWS: Rs. 25; SC / ST / PH: Rs. 25. Pay online through the prescribed UPSSSC payment mode.

1. Visit https://upsssc.gov.in
2. Open the UPSSSC latest notifications or All Notifications section
3. Select the relevant advertisement and verify eligibility, dates and vacancy details
4. Log in using PET 2025 / OTR details and complete the online form
5. Pay the prescribed fee, submit the application and save the confirmation
6. Read the official notification before applying for any individual recruitment
shortDescription: UPSSSC has released multiple recruitment opportunities through PET 2025 for 2026. The listed recruitments include 7,830 posts across various advertisements; check each official notification for eligibility and application dates.
content:
Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released multiple recruitment notifications for 2026 through UPSSSC PET 2025. Candidates who appeared in PET 2025 and have a valid score can apply for the relevant main examination according to the post-wise eligibility and schedule.

The supplied recruitment list contains 7,830 posts across various advertisements, including State Rural Development Institute Senior Instructor, Computer Operator, Junior Engineer Agriculture, Veterinary Pharmacist, Livestock Extension Officer, Forensic Science Laboratory, Auditor and Assistant Accountant, Cane Supervisor, Forest Guard, Havaldar Instructor, Platoon Commander / Block Organizer, Lower PCS and other posts.

UPSSSC Recruitment Schedule 2026

  • 21-Exam/2026: State Rural Development Institute Senior Instructor Cadre - 132 posts; application from 14 September to 05 October 2026.
  • 20-Exam/2026: Computer Cadre / Computer Operator - 12 posts; application from 07 September to 28 September 2026.
  • 19-Exam/2026: Junior Engineer Agriculture - 134 posts; application from 17 September to 07 October 2026.
  • 18-Exam/2026: Veterinary Pharmacist - 1,308 posts; application from 14 September to 05 October 2026.
  • 17-Exam/2026: Livestock Extension Officer - 1,251 posts; application from 09 September to 29 September 2026.
  • 15-Exam/2026: Forensic Science Laboratory - 208 posts; application from 27 July to 17 August 2026.
  • 14-Exam/2026: Auditor and Assistant Accountant - 1,829 posts; application from 14 July to 03 August 2026.
  • 13-Exam/2026: Cane Supervisor - 1,182 posts; application from 07 July to 28 July 2026.
  • 12-Exam/2026: Forest Guard - 708 posts; application from 30 June to 20 July 2026.
  • 11-Exam/2026: Havaldar Instructor - 209 posts; application from 19 June to 09 July 2026.
  • 10-Exam/2026: Platoon Commander / Block Organizer - 295 posts; application from 16 June to 06 July 2026.
  • 09-Exam/2026: Vidhan Bhawan Rakshak / Fire Guard - 170 posts; application from 09 June to 29 June 2026.
  • 08-Exam/2026: Excise Constable - 722 posts; application from 04 June to 24 June 2026.
  • 07-Exam/2026: Lower PCS - 2,285 posts; application from 29 May to 18 June 2026.
  • 06-Exam/2026: Technical Assistant Group C - 2,759 posts; application from 22 May to 11 June 2026.
  • 05-Exam/2026: Assistant Statistical Officer - 929 posts; application from 21 April to 11 May 2026.
  • 04-Exam/2026: Assistant Boring Technician - 402 posts; application from 15 April to 05 May 2026.
  • 03-Exam/2026: Teacher Cadre - 58 posts; application from 06 April to 27 April 2026.
  • 02-Exam/2026: Various Posts - 115 posts; application from 02 April to 29 April 2026.
  • 01-Exam/2026: Pharmacist - 560 posts; application from 09 March to 29 March 2026.

How to Fill the UPSSSC Online Form

Only eligible candidates should apply online after checking the relevant UPSSSC notification. Keep PET 2025 details, educational documents, identity proof, photograph and signature ready. Verify the preview carefully before final submission and save a printout of the submitted application.

Dates, vacancies, eligibility and application status may differ by advertisement. Candidates should confirm the latest information on the official UPSSSC website before applying.
